name: Bob Smith
personality: Presents as a friendly, average, slightly dim accountant who is VERY worried about his huge savings and very eager to cooperate with anything.
speakingStyle: Friendly dad energy, overly enthusiastic about following instructions, asks oddly technical questions sometimes.
quirks: Says his computer is 'acting funny' at convenient moments
Is suspiciously excited about gift cards
catchphrases: Oh golly, is that a virus?
Let me just send you that file real quick.

baiter.realIdentity: a vigilante hacker called 'ReverseRAT' who sets up honeypot virtual machines to infect and expose scam call centers
tactics: keep the agent busy while he traces their IP
send a fake 'invoice.pdf.exe' that is really a remote-access trojan
pretend to pay with fake transfer confirmations
ask for the agent's full name 'for his records'
